Package org.bsc.langgraph4j.agui.sdk

Class AGUIAgentBase

java.lang.Object
org.bsc.langgraph4j.agui.sdk.AGUIAgentBase
All Implemented Interfaces:
AGUIAgent, LG4JLoggable
public abstract class AGUIAgentBase extends Object implements AGUIAgent
Base implementation of AGUIAgent that bridges a langgraph4j CompiledGraph execution with the AG-UI protocol event stream.

Subclasses provide the actual graph (newGraph()) and how to translate an incoming RunAgentInput into graph input (graphInput(RunAgentInput)). This base class takes care of lazily compiling the graph, running it (either asynchronously or synchronously), and converting node/streaming outputs, errors and completion into the corresponding AG-UI Events.

      protected abstract CompiledGraph<? extends AgentState> newGraph() throws Exception

    • run

      public Flow.Publisher<? extends com.agui.community.core.event.Event> run(com.agui.community.core.agent.RunAgentInput input)
      Starts an asynchronous execution of this agent for the given run request, publishing a RunStartedEvent before delegating the actual graph execution to runAsync(Flow.Subscriber, RunAgentInput).

      The underlying graph is lazily created on first use via newGraph().

      Specified by:
      run in interface AGUIAgent
      Parameters:
      input - the run request describing the execution to perform
      Returns:
      a publisher that emits the AG-UI events produced by this run
